input.idea: Recycling agricultural waste into activated carbon, biochar, wood vinegar, and wood pellets
input.target_customer: Mix of domestic (Egypt) and export buyers
known_constraints: Idea stage only — no land or equipment secured yet
Target capacity: 10 t/day activated carbon, 20 t/day biochar, 10 t/day wood pellets

expected_output_shape.idea_summary: A facility in Rashid, Beheira that converts agricultural waste into four saleable products — activated carbon, biochar, wood vinegar, and wood pellets — for both the Egyptian market and export.
expected_output_shape.value_proposition: For agricultural producers and industrial buyers in Egypt, this facility turns crop waste into higher-value carbon products, unlike current waste disposal that captures none of that value.

assumptions.assumption: Sufficient, consistent agricultural waste feedstock is available near Rashid year-round
Export markets will pay a premium over domestic price for activated carbon
Required land and equipment can be secured within budget

open_questions: Is any funding source already identified, or is this fully unfunded?
Is land in Rashid already zoned for industrial/processing use?
Which product (activated carbon, biochar, wood vinegar, pellets) is the primary revenue driver vs. a byproduct?
risks_preview: Feedstock supply may be seasonal, requiring storage capacity
Four product lines at once increases operational complexity for a first-time facility
Export logistics/certification requirements unknown at idea stage

note: This is a worked example for testing the skill, not a validated business assessment.
